show.name: First Responders
show.summary: New Zealand averages 870,000 calls for urgent help every year. This series takes viewers out on rescue helicopters, ambulances & boats with emergency teams as they attend to desperate situations.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Репортаж-2035
show.summary: 2035. An investigative journalist informs the FSB and the GRU that he has discovered an AI assistant developed for criminals. After hacking the program, the heroes gain access to the archives of the world's major terrorist attacks. They are forced to implant neurochips in themselves in order to penetrate the darknet metaverse and stop the evil.

show.name: Swallowed Star
show.summary: One day, an unexplained RR virus appeared on the earth, drawing the world into disaster. Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

show.name: Wan Jie Du Zun
show.summary: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: GuAn
show.summary: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: Bionic Trace
show.summary: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.

Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.

One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.

Only my will… is eternal.

A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.

(Source: Novel Updates)

It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

body.name: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
body.summary:
Finals MVP Jalen Brunson, five-time NBA All-Star Karl-Anthony Towns and the defending champion New York Knicks host 2026 All-NBA First Team selection Cade Cunningham and the Detroit Pistons from Madison Square Garden in New York City.

The Knicks, who won their first NBA championship since 1973 in June, return all five starters from the franchise's playoff run (Brunson, Towns, OG Anunoby, Mikal Bridges, Josh Hart) as they aim for another deep postseason in a revamped Eastern Conference. The Pistons, coming off a 2025-26 season that saw them earn the No. 1 seed in the Eastern Conference, bring back Cunningham, 2026 All-NBA Third Team selection Jalen Duren, and 2026 NBA All-Defensive First Team selection Ausar Thompson.
